$comment: Per-command MCP tool scoping. Tool-selection accuracy falls off once the agent must choose among too many tools, so a command should only see the MCP servers it actually needs. Each command lists the servers it needs; every other known server is added to disallowedTools for that command. Built-in tools (Read, Bash, Edit, etc.) are never restricted, so scoping can tighten the surface without breaking a command. Commands not listed here run unscoped (backward compatible) -- add a command to opt it in. Matchers are server-level (mcp__<server>), which the SDK expands to all tools on that server.
